This paragraph has no measure at all, so on a wide desktop screen every line stretches across the whole window and the eye loses its place when it returns to the start of the next line, which is exactly the problem a sensible max-width solves without any extra effort. Long lines also make it harder to judge where a sentence ends, so readers skim instead of reading, and the page feels heavier than the words on it deserve to be. A narrower column fixes all of that at once.
